question: In March 2024, Sukhbir Singh Sandhu, a 1988 batch Uttarakhand cadre officer of the Indian Administrative Service, joined which of the following departments of the Indian Government?

options.text: Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG)

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Election Commission of India (ECI)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sukhbir Singh Sandhu**, a 1988 batch officer of the **Indian Administrative Service** (IAS) and belonging to the **Uttarakhand cadre**, joined the **Election Commission of India (ECI)** in March 2024.
 
• The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** is an independent constitutional authority responsible for administering elections in India at the **national, state, and local levels**.
 
• It operates under the provisions of **Article 324** of the **Indian Constitution**, ensuring free and fair elections.
 
• The Commission is composed of a **Chief Election Commissioner (CEC)** and two other **Election Commissioners**.
 
• **Sukhbir Singh Sandhu** is known for his vast administrative experience and was previously involved in crucial roles, such as serving as the **Chairman of the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI)**.
 
• His appointment to the ECI reflects the importance of experienced administrators in maintaining the integrity of India’s electoral processes.
 
• The ECI is tasked with ensuring compliance with the **Model Code of Conduct**, managing voter registration, and supervising the election process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**__

 __
 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** is the **central bank of India**, established in **1935**.
 
• Its primary functions include regulating the **monetary policy**, maintaining financial stability, and issuing currency.
 
• The RBI plays a crucial role in managing **inflation**, supervising banks, and ensuring economic stability.
 
 
 
• **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)**__
 __
 
• The **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)** is a constitutional body established under **Article 315** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It conducts examinations for appointments to the **All India Services** and other key government posts.
 
• UPSC is responsible for recruiting personnel based on merit and ensures a transparent selection process.
 
 
 
• **Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG)**__
 
 
• The **Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG)** is an independent authority established under **Article 148** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The CAG audits the accounts of the Union, State Governments, and public sector organizations.
 
• It ensures accountability in the usage of public funds and submits audit reports to the **President of India**.
